title: Understand your Business Profile performance & insights - Google Business Profile Help

facts.fact: Google Business Profile performance data is available only for verified Business Profiles.
facts.quote: Performance data is available only for verified Business Profiles.

facts.fact: To check Business Profile performance, the user must be signed in to the Google Account associated with the profile.
facts.quote: To check your Business Profile performance, you must be signed in to the Google Account associated with your profile.

facts.fact: The Business Profile Insights feature may not be available for all Business Profiles.
facts.quote: The Insights feature may not be available for all Business Profiles.

facts.fact: Google states that a business's Insights are created from public, location-based information such as customer reviews, photos, and local search trends.
facts.quote: Your business’s insights are created based on public, location-based information, such as customer reviews, photos, and local search trends.

facts.fact: Users who manage multiple Business Profiles can download performance data for several profiles at once in a spreadsheet to compare locations.
facts.quote: If you manage multiple Business Profiles, you can download performance data for multiple profiles at once in a spreadsheet to compare the performance of different locations.

facts.fact: Google notes that a profile not enabled for downloads may show "***" in the columns of its performance spreadsheet.
facts.quote: If you haven’t enabled your profile for downloads, you might find “***” in the columns of your performance spreadsheet.

facts.fact: Users can set a date range to track Business Profile performance over a period of time.
facts.quote: You can set a date range to track your Business Profile performance over a period of time.
